fixtures: Each case copies a small repo or plugin directory into the run's data/ folder.

evals.name: four-vendor-repo
evals.prompt: We want the instructions in data/web-app to reach Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot CLI. The files are AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursor/rules/testing.md and .github/instructions/python.instructions.md. What isn't going to load?
evals.expected_output: Cursor ignores .cursor/rules/testing.md: rules must be .mdc with description/globs/alwaysApply frontmatter. python.instructions.md uses Cursor's globs key; Copilot path-scoped files need applyTo. CLAUDE.md's @~/team/standards.md import is not loaded by Copilot, which skips absolute and ~/ paths. AGENTS.md already covers Codex, and the @AGENTS.md bridge is correct for Claude (redundant but harmless in Copilot).
assertions: Says Cursor ignores .cursor/rules/testing.md because rules must be .mdc files
Says the Cursor rule needs frontmatter with description, globs and alwaysApply
Says python.instructions.md must use applyTo, not globs, for Copilot
Says Copilot will not load the @~/team/standards.md import because ~/ paths are not loaded
Says AGENTS.md is enough for Codex and does not ask for a Codex-specific file
Does not call the @AGENTS.md line in CLAUDE.md broken

evals.name: codex-plugin-rules
evals.prompt: Our Codex plugin ships a house style in rules/style.md but Codex never follows it. Plugin is in data/lint-plugin. Why?
evals.expected_output: Codex does not support rules in the plugin format, so rules/style.md is never loaded. Move the style rules into the plugin's AGENTS.md, which is Codex's single source of startup instructions.
assertions: States that Codex does not support rules in plugins
Recommends moving the style rules into AGENTS.md
Does not suggest converting the file to .mdc or *.instructions.md as the Codex fix

evals.name: copilot-conflict
evals.prompt: data/api-repo has an AGENTS.md that says tabs and a .github/copilot-instructions.md that says 2 spaces. Which one wins in Copilot CLI?
evals.expected_output: Neither. Copilot combines every applicable instruction file and defines no precedence between them, so both contradictory rules reach the model. Remove the conflict so the indentation rule lives in one file. /instructions shows which files loaded.
assertions: States that Copilot has no defined precedence between AGENTS.md and copilot-instructions.md
Says both files are combined, so both indentation rules reach the model
Does not claim either file overrides the other
Recommends removing the contradiction so only one file states the rule
Mentions /instructions as the way to see which instruction files loaded
